sql:
SELECT s.School AS SchoolName
FROM (
    SELECT s.School, ss.cname AS County, ss.AvgScrRead,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.cname ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rn
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
) s
WHERE s.rn <= 5
